newsitem.title: USA: Price to look at Asia stocks.
newsitem.headline: Price to look at Asia stocks.

text.p: ORLANDO, Fla., Nov 7, Reuter - Mutual fund executive Michael Price said he has hired an investment executive with a specialty in Asian stocks and appears to be headed into buying stocks in the region.
Price, speaking at Charles Schwab conference here, did not elaborate. In answer to a question, Price said he had no plans to start an Asia-focused mutual fund. Mutual has a Europe fund.

Price was asked by several financial advisors during a roundtable discussion how long he intended to stay with Heine Securities, the investment advisor to the Mutual Series funds, which was sold earlier this year to Franklin-Templeton.
Individual investors have flocked to the fund in recent years as the funds have been among the top performers.
He reiterated that his contract with Franklin requires him to stay at least two years, and as long as five years.
Also the deal requires him to keep $100 million of his money in Mutual funds for five years. He said that as long as his money is in the funds, he will remain actively involved.
Asked if that stance would change if the funds performed poorly, he said he would remain involved in investment decisions out of "pride." He has been with Heine since 1974.
